title: Borrowing a Tool Instead of Buying It
title_ja: 道具を買わずに借りる選択

source_links.title: Ellen MacArthur Foundation: Circular Business Models

fact_notes: 背景となる考え方は添付の資料で確認。本文と練習問題は新規制作。例示した人物・学校・活動は架空の説明用設定。

sentences.en: A family needs a special tool to repair one small part of its garden fence.
sentences.ja: ある家族は庭の柵の小さな部分を直すため特別な道具が必要です。

sentences.en: Buying the tool would be expensive, and it might be used only once.
sentences.ja: 道具の購入は高価で、一度しか使わないかもしれません。

sentences.en: However, a nearby community center offers tools that residents can borrow.
sentences.ja: しかし近くの地域センターは住民が借りられる道具を提供しています。

sentences.en: The family pays a small fee and returns the tool after finishing the repair.
sentences.ja: 家族は少額を払い、修理後に道具を返します。

sentences.en: This approach gives people access to products without requiring everyone to own them.
sentences.ja: この方法は全員が所有しなくても製品を利用できるようにします。

sentences.en: Sharing products can be part of what is called a circular economy.
sentences.ja: 製品の共有は循環型経済と呼ばれる考え方の一部になり得ます。

sentences.en: A business that rents equipment must think about how items will be used repeatedly.
sentences.ja: 機器を貸し出す事業は道具が繰り返し使われる方法を考える必要があります。

sentences.en: For example, the tool should be strong enough to survive many customers and simple to repair.
sentences.ja: 例えば道具は多くの利用者に耐える強さがあり、修理しやすいことが望まれます。

sentences.en: Workers also need to check whether an item is safe before lending it again.
sentences.ja: 職員は再び貸す前に安全か確認する必要もあります。

sentences.en: A broken product may cause harm even when sharing it seems economical.
sentences.ja: 壊れた製品は共有が経済的に見えても害を生むかもしれません。

sentences.en: The price of renting must therefore help cover cleaning, maintenance, and replacement when necessary.
sentences.ja: そのため貸出料金には必要な清掃、維持、交換の費用も考慮する必要があります。

sentences.en: A successful sharing service needs a practical plan, not simply a collection of old objects.
sentences.ja: 共有サービスの成功には古い物を集めるだけでなく、実際的な計画が必要です。

sentences.en: Customers must also decide whether borrowing suits their needs.
sentences.ja: 利用者も借りることが必要に合うか判断しなければなりません。

sentences.en: In addition, a person who uses a tool every day might find ownership more convenient.
sentences.ja: さらに毎日道具を使う人には所有の方が便利かもしれません。

sentences.en: Some communities lack a nearby place where products can be returned.
sentences.ja: 返却できる場所が近くにない地域もあります。

sentences.en: Others may need clear instructions in several languages to use a tool safely.
sentences.ja: 安全な使用のため複数言語の明確な説明が必要な人もいます。

sentences.en: A fair service should consider who can reach it and who might be left out.
sentences.ja: 公正なサービスでは誰が利用でき、誰が取り残されるか考えるべきです。

sentences.en: Sharing is useful only when the service works for real people in real situations.
sentences.ja: 共有は実際の人々の状況に合うときに役立ちます。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, borrowing cannot solve every problem connected with waste.
sentences.ja: それでも借りることですべてのごみの問題が解決するわけではありません。

sentences.en: Products still need materials and energy, and they will eventually wear out.
sentences.ja: 製品は素材とエネルギーを必要とし、いつかは摩耗します。

sentences.en: Students can compare the cost and environmental effects of buying, borrowing, and repairing.
sentences.ja: 生徒は購入・借用・修理の費用と環境への影響を比較できます。

sentences.en: They should describe their assumptions rather than announce one answer for every situation.
sentences.ja: どの状況にも一つの答えを宣言するのではなく前提条件を説明すべきです。

sentences.en: The central question is whether people need to own a product or simply need to use it.
sentences.ja: 中心となる問いは製品を所有する必要があるのか、使えればよいのかということです。

options: Sharing goods can be useful when access, maintenance, and real needs are considered.
Every customer should use the same tool.
questions.explanation_ja: 必要な道具を共有する利点と課題が主題です。

questions.prompt: Why does the family choose to borrow?
options: The tool is free to keep.
Buying a tool for one use would be expensive.
The community center sells no tools.
questions.explanation_ja: 一度の使用のために買うと高価だからです。

questions.prompt: Why can renting reduce unnecessary ownership?
options: Several people can use one product at different times.
questions.explanation_ja: 一つの道具を複数人が順に利用できるためです。

questions.prompt: What should workers check before lending a tool again?
questions.explanation_ja: 安全性の確認が必要です。

questions.prompt: What costs may rental fees need to cover?
questions.explanation_ja: 清掃・維持管理・交換の費用を挙げます。

questions.prompt: When might buying be preferable to borrowing?
options: When there is no plan to use a product.
When an item cannot be repaired.
When someone needs the tool frequently.
When a product is easy to return.
questions.explanation_ja: 頻繁に使う場合は所有が便利なことがあります。

options: Work that keeps equipment in usable condition.
questions.explanation_ja: maintenanceは維持管理のことです。

questions.prompt: Why might some people struggle to use a sharing service?
options: No one wants to repair anything.
There may be no nearby return location.
questions.explanation_ja: 返却場所が近くにないことが課題になります。

questions.prompt: Why doesn't borrowing completely eliminate waste?
options: Shared products also wear out and require resources.
Only purchased tools are made in factories.
questions.explanation_ja: 共有品も素材を使い、摩耗していくためです。

questions.prompt: What does the final sentence encourage?
options: Thinking about access rather than assuming ownership is necessary.
questions.explanation_ja: 所有と利用の違いを考える結びです。
